# National Hispanic American Heritage Month

> > Official U.S. government site celebrating National Hispanic American Heritage Month (September 15 - October 15) with exhibits, multimedia resources, and profiles of notable Hispanic and Latino leaders.

This federal observance, established by Public Law 100-402 under President Reagan, honors the contributions of Hispanic Americans to U.S. history and culture. The site features curated content from the Library of Congress, Smithsonian Institution, National Archives, and other cultural institutions.

## Key Topics

- Hispanic Heritage Month (September 15 - October 15)
- Library of Congress
- Smithsonian Institution
- National Archives
- Latino cultural icons and leaders
- Gloria Estefan and Emilio Estefan
- Celia Cruz
- Juan Felipe Herrera
- Diego Rivera
- Gershwin Prize
- Mexico, Spain, and Caribbean heritage
- Civil rights and Latino activism
- Federal observance and legislative history
- National Gallery of Art
- National Endowment for the Humanities

## About Hispanic Heritage Month

- [History of Hispanic Heritage Month](https://hispanicheritagemonth.gov/About.html): History of Hispanic Heritage Month from Johnson to Reagan (Public Law 100-402)

## Cultural Resources and Exhibits

- [Exhibits and Collections](https://hispanicheritagemonth.gov/exhibits-and-collections.html): Curated exhibits from National Archives, National Gallery & Smithsonian
- [Photo Gallery](https://hispanicheritagemonth.gov/Images.html): Photo gallery featuring Gloria Estefan, Celia Cruz & Hispanic icons
- [Audio and Video Resources](https://hispanicheritagemonth.gov/audio-and-video.html): Multimedia resources from Library of Congress & Smithsonian Institution
